description: Default capability for the GameLib shell: core defaults plus the opener plugin (the shell.openExternal / steam:// parity path). Tauri v2 capabilities gate WEBVIEW->Rust IPC only; they are not consulted for Rust-side plugin API calls. The four app-defined relay commands (sidecar_invoke, sidecar_send, open_external, sidecar_store_snapshot) are registered via invoke_handler and do not require capability permissions. For the same reason the native file/folder picker (dialog.showOpenDialog parity, plan 30-03) needs NO dialog permission here: dispatch_rust_channel calls app.dialog().file() from Rust. Granting 'dialog:allow-open' would have exposed plugin:dialog|open directly to renderer JavaScript (including anything running in the store WebView surface) for zero benefit to the intended path — WR-03.
